name: Biển Hồ shrimp
summary: The 22 July 2022 tourism article names tép Biển Hồ among Gia Lai’s known plates, and describes it seasoned and dried on rice paper. Any other preparation is Check on arrival.
origin: The river-food article lists tép Biển Hồ with phở khô, grilled chicken and bamboo rice, sun-dried beef, heo sọc dưa, and cassava leaf with bitter eggplant. The only method in that article is the rice-paper one.
howToEat: Season the shrimp and spread them on rice paper, then dry the sheet. That is the relative’s dish that led to the anchovy cracker.
A fresh preparation is Check on arrival.
where: Biển Hồ is the shrimp the article names. A stall address is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
